text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with Acute Exacerbation. Given your 20-year smoking history, occupational dust exposure, subacute cough lasting four weeks, and yellowish sputum without systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, the clinical picture strongly points to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbated by environmental irritants. The absence of wheezing or chest pain makes asthma or pneumonia less likely at this stage.
